1. COVERAGE, denominator = every common input id
   N total                     400

   generation completed        400

     SUCCESS                    392

2. CD, conditional.  n = 392 of 400
   median 0.1864   mean 1.3129
   p25 0.0766   p75 0.3788
   CD / that part's own sampling floor:
     median 1.243   p25 1.022   p75 3.108
     at or below 1x floor  36/392
     at or below 2x floor  261/392
   The ratio matters more than the raw median: the floor varies about
   fiftyfold across these shapes, so one global figure would not say
   whether a CD is near the metric's resolution or far from it.

4. AUDITS
   duplicate manifests         0
   non-terminal manifests      0  (should be 0)
   generation seconds          median 1.71, max 12.47
   first half vs second half   1.56 vs 1.83

5. QUALITATIVE EXAMPLES, chosen by the rule fixed before these results existed
   median IoU        f360_31962_e5291336_0005  (0.9380)
   25th percentile   f360_121262_f4a03dbc_0000  (0.7908)
   failure case      f360_34781_4f8a4759_0017
   Not the prettiest reconstruction: a figure chosen after the fact
   illustrates the choosing, not the method.

No aggregate 'geometry score' is computed. Coverage plus conditional geometry
says what happened; a blended number would hide which half moved.
